blocker.reason: The original holder-by-issuer boundary remains blocked by canonical Accounting Readiness. The preregistered aggregate recovery path A-D also remains negative: Phase A explicit F2-F8 aggregation failed on eight unavailable component series; historical Phase B exact F-minus-F1 aggregation resolved mandatory coverage and produced 45 common quarters but failed the frozen stock reconciliation gate; Phase C showed that five stock residuals also exceeded the ECB DECIMALS-derived rounding envelope; and Phase D localized those discrepancies primarily to resident-sector additivity versus direct S1 rather than to the S1-rest-of-world relation. A later post-run ESA F1 structural-zero refinement was tested exploratorily and failed by large reconciliation margins. A retained F1/F11/F12 diagnostic then showed why: published S12/S121 F1 liabilities are non-zero F12/SDR liabilities, so the exploratory resident-F1-liability zero rule is rejected. This does not reinterpret historical A-D; it instead restores confidence that the immutable Phase B source-required treatment must govern that evidence chain. The mode remains PARTIAL_SERIES_AVAILABLE and further internal source reinterpretation is frozen until a declared external reopen trigger. The separately preregistered post-run S1N diagnostic has now also been executed: all eight exact Romania QSA S1N F/F1 asset/liability stock/flow queries returned ECB HTTP 404 ('No Series was returned for the query'), with no network errors. The S1N coverage gate therefore failed and supplied NO_REOPEN_EVIDENCE_FROM_S1N. This result is retained as negative source evidence and changes neither historical A-D nor the 9/10 reference-mode readiness state.

reopen_condition: Promote only after either (a) the canonical Accounting Readiness Gate establishes complete stock and flow matrices for the original holder-by-issuer boundary, or (b) a separately preregistered aggregate reference boundary passes an immutable source gate on the exact RMD instrument scope without missing-to-zero, synthetic allocation, post-result sector dropping or stock-difference flow proxies.

post_run_review_effect.rule: A future corrected F1-applicability test requires a new separately preregistered phase. The historical Phase B contract and A-D evidence chain remain immutable.
